decisive_spans.text: Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed enhancement confined to the peripheral rim of the mass

response.rationale: D5 is supported by the MRI findings of an intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau and peripheral rim enhancement. D3 also has peripheral rim enhancement, but D5 is a more common cause of intra-articular space-occupying lesions in the knee.
